t: Durango Men's Maverick XP Steel Toe Waterproof Western Work Boots (DDB0176)
d:
Details 
 This is the men's 11" Western Waterproof Steel Toe Chocolate Safari Elephant/ Black Durango® Maverick XP™. This style is full-grain leather with a faux exotic elephant embossed vamp, collar and pull straps with a faux shaft. Inside it has a soft mesh lining and a Durango® Waterproof membrane bootie to keep your feel dry all day long. It has the Durango® X-Pand System™ which is a hidden gore expansion on the inside medial seam for a universal fit and easy on/off.
 It also has the Durango X-Treme Comfort footed with Memory Foam for all day comfort and support. The heel counter is high abrasion and the shank is fiberglass for lightweight stability. This style has a dual-density midsole with a firmer shock absorbing heel for added stability and a soft shock absorbing forepart for ultimate flexibility and comfort. The rolled shank area and anti-torsion ridged external shank provides added lateral stability and the outsole is a multi-durometer rubber with high abrasion outer lugs for high impact durability and softer durometer mid lugs for added flexibility and increased slip and oil resistance. It has a double row sole stitch around the square toe for added durability and a 1 ½" rocker heel.
